description: Single source of truth for model IDs. parallel-review selects offline review tiers (1..2; unspecified/auto means L1), each with exactly two Pi reviewers in Codex then Claude order. Tier attempt budgets live in reviewTimeouts. Claude and OpenAI handle normal review and implementation; Grok is reserved for research. The `impl.muse` role is a separate Meta Contributor route for the impl skill: the runner selects it automatically only when --role is omitted during an active Meta Muse Wonder/Spark Pi model (external sharing still needs explicit approval), and it is never a fallback. Roles name one model per consumer: .pi for Pi headless, .agy for Antigravity CLI (resolve with --field agy), .cursor for Cursor Agent CLI (resolve with --field cursor), .id for other tools such as Codex.

impl.muse.label: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor High (Meta OSS, explicit opt-in)
